main.summary: Provides server-native transfer session state and payload operations.

method.name: LoadRecoveryStateForAdminAsync
method.summary: Loads a consistent administrative snapshot of one session and its persisted recovery state.
method.returns: The recovery snapshot; its session is null when the session does not exist.

method.name: CloseReadSessionAsync
method.summary: Closes one catalog-scoped read-mode transfer session and removes its tenant payload and metadata.
method.param: Expected item identifier for the session.
method.returns: True when the session was closed or already absent; false when identity or lifecycle state prevents closure.

method.name: HasDependentSessionAsync
method.summary: Checks whether a staged-read or stream-follow session still depends on the specified source in the selected catalog.
method.returns: True when at least one dependent session exists.

method.name: LoadStaleTransferSessionCandidatesAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded cursor page of sessions in the selected tenant catalog whose last server-observed activity is at or before a fixed cleanup cutoff.
method.param: Inclusive activity cutoff for this scan.
Exclusive cursor from the preceding page for this tenant catalog, or null for the first page.
Maximum number of lightweight candidates to return.
method.returns: The next stale-session candidate page.

method.name: PurgeRecoveryStateAsync
method.summary: Conditionally deletes one session's database recovery state when the expected session and journal freshness values still match.
method.param: Expected item identifier for the session.
Expected session state version from the inspection snapshot.
Expected journal operation identifier, or null when no journal exists.
Expected journal phase, or null when no journal exists.
Expected journal update time, or null when no journal exists.
method.returns: True when the expected state was deleted; otherwise false.

method.name: TouchTransferSessionAsync
method.summary: Advances the server-observed activity timestamp for one tenant-scoped session without changing its manifest or transfer state version.
method.returns: True when the matching session was touched.

method.name: LoadSegmentedManifestAsync
method.summary: Loads a segmented transfer manifest and its realized ranges only when its serialized item instance token matches the persisted session token.
method.returns: The segmented manifest, or null when the session is missing or belongs to another transfer family.

method.name: LoadSegmentedWriteManifestAsync
method.summary: Loads segmented session metadata without materializing coverage.
method.returns: The manifest or null.

method.name: IsSegmentedRangeCoveredAsync
method.summary: Checks whether the requested range is covered.
method.returns: True when coverage contains the range.

method.name: LoadStreamManifestAsync
method.summary: Loads a stream transfer manifest and its current object payload only when its serialized item instance token matches the persisted session token.
method.returns: The stream manifest, or null when the session is missing or belongs to another transfer family.

method.name: RecomputeIntegrityAsync
method.summary: Computes integrity from the session's persisted segment evidence.
method.returns: The computed integrity, or null when the session or evidence is unavailable or invalid.

method.name: LoadIntegritySegmentsAsync
method.summary: Loads ordered integrity segment evidence for a transfer session.
method.returns: Ordered segment evidence, or null when the session is missing or unsupported.

method.name: LoadSessionsAsync
method.summary: Loads transfer sessions matching indexed filters and the required catalog filter.
method.param: Session filters with the authorized CatalogName.
method.returns: The matching transfer sessions.

method.name: LoadSessionsForAdminAsync
method.summary: Loads transfer sessions across catalogs for an admin-authorized inventory operation.
method.returns: The matching sessions across catalogs.

method.name: SaveObjectAsync
method.summary: Stores an immutable serialized object payload.
method.returns: The stored payload reference, or null when no payload was stored.

method.name: ReplaceObjectAsync
method.summary: Replaces the serialized object payload for a transfer session.
method.returns: The replacement payload reference, or null when no payload was stored.

method.name: WriteVerifiedSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Verifies and atomically commits a request range with session progress; accepts an identical retry without advancing the version.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected range result with authoritative state version.

method.name: CreateSegmentedSessionAsync
method.summary: Stores the initial object payload and segmented transfer manifest.
method.returns: The stored object reference, or null when storage does not return one.

method.name: CreateStreamSessionAsync
method.summary: Stores the initial stream object payload and stream transfer manifest.
method.returns: The stored object reference, or null when storage does not return one.

method.name: WriteStreamChunkAsync
method.summary: Stores an append chunk when it is the next valid chunk for the stream.
method.returns: The accepted or rejected append result.

method.name: WriteVerifiedStreamChunkAsync
method.summary: Verifies an append payload and atomically commits its chunk record with updated stream-session progress; an identical payload at an occupied offset is treated as a replay.
method.returns: The committed, replayed, or rejected append result with authoritative progress.

method.name: SaveSegmentedManifestAsync
method.summary: Sanitizes and persists a segmented transfer manifest.
method.returns: A task representing the persistence operation.

method.name: PromoteStagedReadManifestAsync
method.summary: Persists the published-read transition for an existing staged-read follow manifest with a matching source session.
method.param: Published-read manifest to persist for the existing session.
method.returns: True when the existing staged-read session was promoted; otherwise false.

method.name: SaveStreamManifestAsync
method.summary: Sanitizes and persists a stream transfer manifest.
method.returns: A task representing the persistence operation.

method.name: OpenObjectAsync
method.summary: Opens the serialized object payload for a transfer session.
method.returns: The object payload stream, or null when it does not exist.

method.name: ReadObjectPayloadAsync
method.summary: Reads the serialized object payload fully into memory.
method.returns: The object payload bytes, or null when it does not exist.

method.name: OpenSegmentedRangeAsync
method.summary: Opens a composite stream over contiguous realized segmented ranges.
method.returns: A composite range stream, or null when the requested range is not fully covered.

method.name: OpenStreamRangeAsync
method.summary: Opens a composite stream over contiguous stream chunks.
method.returns: A composite range stream, or null when the requested range is not fully covered.

method.name: DeleteSessionAsync
method.summary: Deletes all metadata and payloads owned by a transfer session.
method.returns: True when metadata or payloads were deleted.

method.name: LoadObjectReferenceAsync
method.summary: Loads the persisted object reference for a transfer session.
method.returns: The tenant storage object reference, or null when the session or object reference is unavailable.

method.name: CreateSegmentedBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted segmented ranges of a session.
method.returns: The segmented block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not segmented.

method.name: CreateStreamBlockPlanAsync
method.summary: Creates a deterministic storage block plan from the persisted stream chunks of a session.
method.returns: The stream block plan, or null when the session is unavailable or is not a stream transfer.
